summary: Sets out requirements for a generic route-tracing tool and the protocol behind it. Operators would use it to check that IP forwarding works properly. It goes beyond traceroute, which finds the path between two interfaces, by also revealing details of the tunnels that carry traffic along that path.

eli5.summary: Imagine following a trail of footprints to see where a friend walked. Traceroute shows the stops along the way. This idea would also show the secret tunnels the friend slipped through that you could not see before.

questions: how is traceroute different from generic route tracing
how to see tunnels on an ip path
